title:
Bound in Blood
Multiplayer
text: A separate multiplayer copy of your game with every IranCoJ map and mod. Your original game stays untouched.

title: Third Person 1.0.5
text: Press F5 for an over-the-shoulder view. Your character now moves naturally on screen, the camera glides between first and third person, and the middle mouse button swaps shoulders. Skirmish and Manhunt stay first person.

title: Spectate Mod 1.1.0
text: First-person spectating hides the player's face, so the camera no longer clips into beards and eyebrows, and shows a dot crosshair.

title: New Classes 2.0.3
text: Silas Greaves, John Wesley Hardin and Billy the Kid as the Rancher, Duelist and Rifleman. 2.0.3 makes their spawns lighter, gives Billy a paler red shirt and adds the crosshair styles.

title: Lincoln Town
text: The biggest map in the pack so far. It downloads with your next map update.

title: Showdown on IranCoJ
text: Join the IranCoJ server straight from the launcher, no menus needed.
